decisive_items: AFB PCR probe of hilar lymph node was positive
Second FESS AFB PCR probe was positive
response.rationale: R2 is the champion because it has the most direct evidence of tuberculosis, including positive AFB PCR probe results. R4 is the runner-up because it has evidence of noncaseating granulomas, which could be consistent with sarcoidosis, but the positive AFB PCR probe results in R2 make it a more likely diagnosis.

rejected.why: negative ANCA panel results contradict diagnosis of granulomatosis with polyangiitis
append-only completion, not a standalone diagnosis
